row.body: The shell box is signed out at 6:10, the marked route is closed at 5:40, and a spare key is still tied to the map. The return box is blank.
row.title: Inventory closed before the gate

sidecar.gloss: A collection record places a route closure before the return of its equipment.
sidecar.rival_reading: A test crew could have recorded a temporary site closure before retrieving equipment; the blank line does not say who set the schedule.

row.body: road dust coats the lug wrench and hand torch, but their ties are clean and newly cut. the bundle was repacked after travel.
row.title: missing count beside the lug wrench

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.

row.body: Keep the pesticide trial jars sealed until the boundary check is done. The neighbor keeps knocking because the map says don't go; the dog is still in the yard.
row.title: The jars stay sealed

sidecar.gloss: A field-trial warning and a household access problem remain on the same note.
sidecar.rival_reading: A response crew could have sealed ordinary pest-control supplies while closing an area; keeping the jars shut does not show the trial malfunctioned.
